@@ -0,0 +1,193 @@
+# 开发日志 2026-10-18：Citlali6 相机/HIL 统一工程（Issue #17）
+
+- 主仓库由协调 Codex 在干净状态同步最新 main，基线
+  `ee52f09ae78d7163067d627eeae0d627ea92855c`；本任务使用独立 worktree
+  `F:/Amazing_Hand_unified_20261018` 和
+  `feature/citlali6-camera-hil-unified-20261018`。用户已明确授权 commit、push、Draft PR。
+- 全文阅读 Issue #17、AGENTS、团队流程、现有日志、相机交付、接口/架构设计及 PR #12/#13；
+  个人流程只读 `docs/citlali6-ai-workflow-20261017` 中真实文档，未引入或修改团队规范。
+- 只在新 `fpga/camera_hil/` 中实现组合构建：调用原相机 2020.2 版本保护建工程脚本，
+  修改独立副本；原 HPM0_FPD 128-bit interconnect 从 11 扩至 12 MI，M11 接 AHIL AXI/FSM。
+  保留 camera 的 11 个寄存器段、全部 CSI/VDMA/HP1 路径、BD 外部接口、PS、时钟、复位和 XDC。
+  AHIL 新段 `0xA1000000/4KiB` 不与 `0xA0000000–0xA00AFFFF` 冲突。
+- 从未合并 PR #13 的完整 HEAD `caa84a5ddb541cd60ebd2e07869b83671ca8a1e2`
+  选择性原字节继承 AXI/shell/FSM RTL 和 hil_server；来源/hash 在 provenance.json。
+  不修改全局 FSM、不导入旧独立 bit、旧部署器或 PR #15；PC 客户端仍依赖未合并 PR #12。
+  amazinghand-hil/1 schema1 保持不变，未将接口 v0.3 草案当作已实现。
+- 新构建按既有实测 PL0 `200703980Hz` 缩放 AHIL 看门狗，组合实现时覆盖两路 live 时钟约束。
+  新 source/build audit 检查原相机 hash、原 BD 地址/参数/连接及新增 AHIL 连接。
+  新 packager 必须通过实际 2020.2 live-clock 时序、DRC、约束覆盖、bit/XSA 一致性才产出 RAM 包。
+- 新 RAM-only loader 分开“重载前必须无相机/DMA占用”和“同次加载后的 HIL 服务允许相机随后运行”。
+  同一前台进程持锁 load→AHIL 验证/STOP→serve，不提供基于过期 loaded.json 的独立 start；
+  失败加载不得读 AHIL，重载检查 driver/fd/mmap/内核 DMA halt 故障、PS 接口和时钟。
+  原相机固定 hash bin 可单独经批准回退；不执行 psu_init/FSBL、写 SD、安装依赖或自动切换。
+- **真实阻断**：只安装 Vivado 2020.1，用户明确表示没有 2020.2；实际执行新 build.tcl
+  被版本保护拒绝，exit 1，目标构建目录未创建。没有绕过保护、降级/升级 IP 或安装工具。
+  ALINX/Digilent 三个 bundled IP 的 35 个 component 文件引用全部存在，无 protected HDL；
+  2020.2 的 IP lock、许可证和构建尚无法验证，不能声称已通过。
+- **实际验证**：117 个相机归档 SHA256、4 个继承文件 SHA256 一致；7 项 reload 顺序/占用/
+  失败不探测/同次双服务路径/时序和 DRC 拒绝测试通过；Python 编译、Tcl info complete、diff 检查通过。
+  Tcl 完整性和 fake 软件测试不代表 Vivado BD validate、综合、时序或板端通过。
+- **未完成**：未用 2020.2 生成组合 BD/bit/XSA/bin，未综合/实现/DRC，未打包转换或上板。
+  同次加载后 1080p+MuJoCo、模型负载 STOP/独立 watchdog 的实测全部未执行。
+  板卡相机时段归 Issue #16；本任务没有 SSH/PL/驱动操作，没有碰相机原件、SD、拨码、FMC 或舵机。
+- 后续唯一已确认的构建阻断是匹配的 Vivado 2020.2 环境；工具就绪后按 camera_hil/README
+  的单条 impl 命令开始，报告新增真实 IP/许可证/时序问题，现场切换另须用户批准。
+  本文件与 Issue #16 的独立分支同日日志可能产生文本合并冲突，PR 审查时保留双方记录。
+
+## 用户后续授权：仅用现有 2020.1 做真实兼容重建
+
+- 全文读取 Issue #17 评论 `6246288827`。用户新约束明确不安装 2020.2，允许独立、可追踪的
+  2020.1 同系列 IP 等价重建；旧版本门禁失败仅保留为历史证据，不能继续当作技术不兼容结论。
+  沿用本分支/PR #18，不切 main、不合并或重排历史；本轮也明确不启动 Issue #20。
+- 本轮只读核查 `origin/main=6b1c90094e9979d1729a331896954a12821c7ae2`：#12/#13/#14 已合入。
+  与本 B 分支改动文件无交集；四个已复制 HIL 文件和该 main 完全相同，未擅自吸收其他代码。
+  个人规范改为只读 main 中已合并的真实文档。未修改本地 main，也未 merge/rebase/reset/强推。
+- 新 `experimental_2020_1/prepare.py` 从原 BD 配置在全新目录创建 native 2020.1 工程。
+  不修改任何旧 BD/XCI 的版本、不运行 upgrade_ip，不改 strict build.tcl 或 camera_hw 原件。
+  `reconstruction.json` 逐块记录对象、原/新 VLNV、操作和生成 Tcl hash。
+- **真实 probe**：`F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-probe01` 中实际创建 BD、恢复原参数并 report_ip_status。
+  全部原 VLNV 可用，32 个 IP Up-to-date/Included、0 Locked；原 PS 的 1012 个属性全部接受。
+- **真实组合 validate**：`F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-run01` 保留原 32 块并新增 AHIL，真正执行
+  validate_bd_design 成功，写出原生 BD 和 camera_hil_bd.tcl；原全部接口连接、标量连接及
+  camera/DMA 寄存器段/排除段保持。实际工程 BD 与审计副本 hash 相同。
+- **实际综合**：全部 IP OOC 及主 design_1_wrapper 综合成功；主综合 0 Critical Warnings、
+  0 Errors（71 Warnings 仍保留），真实取得 xczu19eg Synthesis license，随后启动实现。
+- 原 117 文件、继承 RTL、生成 BD/XCI 联合审计通过。只允许已实测的元数据差异：PS 保护表
+  新增 FPD_GPV/CCI_GPV 两条（原条目不变）；native 地址空间补 width/range；XCI 实例名、
+  禁用接口、未连接 IRQ0、未使用 concat >=32 输入字段、AXI-IIC outstanding 描述 1→2。
+  这些工具元数据未经板端验收；连接中的图像处理核心模型参数不变。审计拒绝其他差异，
+  特别是 PS/DDR/活动总线或地址变化。新增 XSA 仍绝不能用于 psu_init/FSBL。
+- packager 支持明确标识的 experimental-camera-hil-2020.1，必须先通过该原件/拓扑/XCI 审计，
+  再核实真实 2020.1 时序/DRC/约束覆盖及最终 bit/XSA 一致性；未放松 STOP、watchdog、
+  加载会话绑定、原 profile 回退或固件 hash 检查。必要安全回归 7 项再次通过。
+- 本轮仍仅 PC 离线，未 SSH、未切 PL/装卸 driver、未安装依赖、未改网络/PS 时钟/SD，
+  未接 FMC/舵机或改 SW1。A 独占原相机，组合 profile 即使出 bit 也不自动上板。
+- **最终构建事实**：真实 run01 的 place/route/write_bitstream/write_hw_platform 均完成，Vivado
+  exit 0。bit `F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-run01/vivado/mipi_dp.runs/impl_1/design_1_wrapper.bit`
+  为 12758124 B，SHA256 `85a602b6dceeb10c6e8c0b885c7abf5a1811a8f726cbc5c597555b6138f597f3`；
+  XSA `F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-run01/camera_hil.xsa` 为 2354199 B，SHA256
+  `14e14a19edb20df5b09b4e3901083809c0e545bcdbfb7ee892a6370c1b3990e6`；内嵌唯一 bit 与外部 bit 完全相同。
+  二者只保留本地，不上传 GitHub，均为 **禁止部署的诊断产物**，不等于时序签收。
+- run01 暴露本轮新 XDC 的 `if` 不支持、hier pl_clk 两别名问题。保留实际执行的 rebuild Tcl/hash/
+  原日志；修正当前 prepare.py 的从零复建模板，将断言放普通 Tcl，XDC 复用原唯一 leaf source。
+  实际运行 `repair_clock.tcl ... diagnose`（exit 0），从成功综合读取原 PS8_i/PLCLK[0/1]，
+  对同一个真实 routed DCP 重施 live 时钟，报告证明 PL0/PL1 单源、4.982/9.965ns。
+  **没有重跑修复后的实现，没有生成修复候选 bit**。首轮 bit/XSA 仍归属于原失败签收 attempt。
+- **当前准确阻断**：修正 clock 源后仍 WNS+0.548ns / WHS+0.010ns，但 WPWS−1.649ns，
+  14 个 IDELAYCTRL/REFCLK 最大周期检查要求≤3.333ns，而保留的 PL0 reference 为4.982ns。
+  同时 no_clock2496、unconstrained internal endpoints6036、缺 input/output delay24/8；
+  DRC 有49条 Warning（REQP-1869×48：VDMA URAM cascade tie-low；RTSTAT-10×1：64条无可路由负载net），0 Error。
+  这是2020.1真实重建观测；没有2020.2对照，不能归因于降版本独有，也不能说原源工程在2020.2必过。
+- 真实调用新 packager 识别2020.1后因 timing constraints failed 退出1，无 bin/tar/部署包；
+  保持零 DRC 和完整约束门禁，没有用“仅 Warning”替代通过，没有豁免规则或猜测 MIPI 约束。
+  未实施新 MMCM/300MHz ref、CSI 参数调整、URAM tie-off或无负载net清理。
+- 完整命令、工具日志/报告、489项 native XCI 变动分类、原始/规范化证据 hash、产物 hash 均归档于
+  `fpga/camera_hil/evidence/2020.1/`；其中诊断的 clocks/timing/DRC 在随后 report_methodology 重新读取
+  checkpoint 原失败 XDC 之前生成，这一日志边界已在 README/result.json 说明，不冒称干净重新实现。
+- 后续最小工作是评估保持 PS/DDR/ABI 不变的 PL-local 合规 IDELAYCTRL reference、匹配 CSI delay/reset，
+  补齐真实传感器/lane/板级skew的 MIPI 时序输入，再做经证明的 URAM/无负载修复及一次签收构建。
+  这不是等待安装2020.2；需要设计审查，未来板测另获当前授权，现阶段无需新增接线。

+## P0 授权续作：局部参考、复位、名义 MIPI 时钟与 DRC 修复
+
+- 完整读取 Issue #17 评论 `6246782620`；沿用干净 `e651e96f` 和原分支/PR #18。
+  重读 AGENTS/团队流程/接口/当前日志/个人规则，核查 `ee52..origin/main(6b1c900)` 的
+  #12/#13/#14 变动不与本任务路径相交；未同步、合并、rebase、reset 或切换 main。
+  用户授权仅 PC 离线实际开发/构建、commit/push 和更新现有 Draft；未启动 Issue #20。
+- 原 CSI reference 不只驱动 IDELAYCTRL，也供时钟丢失检测；因此保留该 PL0 路径，
+  仅在 `--repair-csi` 私有副本新增共享 delay reference。DS925 明确 US+ IDELAYCTRL
+  REFCLK 300–800MHz、RST>=52ns；-2 MMCM VCO800–1600MHz。实际 PL0 200.703980MHz
+  经 MMCME4_BASE M6/D1/O4 得301.055970MHz，VCO1204.223880MHz，不改 PS/DDR。
+- 首个 p0-run01 的独立每 CSI MMCM 方案在审查时发现共享 bank 复位不同步风险，
+  已停止本任务主进程及经真实路径/父链核对的专属 OOC runner 子树。保留日志/输出，
+  这是提前停止的设计 attempt，不能说成工具/器件不兼容。run02 仅 prepare exact-context
+  失败，run03 仅准备未启动 Vivado；正式共享版使用全新 p0-run04。
+- 改为一块共享 reference BD module，原32块及 AHIL 保留。四 CSI 私有新增参考/复位/
+  all_ready/RDY 标量端口；五个私有文件（四 HDL+component.xml）由 exact patch 生成，
+  ledger记录前后SHA，auditor重新从原归档计算并逐字节验证。原117文件及四个继承HIL源不变。
+- 共同 lock-loss/reset 异步置位，参考域三级同步释放；IO 原语先释放，32个ref周期后
+  共释放 CTRL reset。SERDES 初始 reset 不以 RDY/byteclock 为前提，避免无相机或停钟死锁；
+  全部 CTRL RDY 同步后，每路应用再等至少64本路byte周期才放行valid。
+  TIME/FIXED、20ps skew、EN_VTC=1 保留；REFCLK_FREQUENCY改301.055970，IDELAY RST
+  从常0改共同IO reset。原 IDELAYCTRL SIM_DEVICE=ULTRASCALE 与UG571对US+要求一致。
+- 聚焦 vendor-unisim XSim 真运行通过：参考周期3.321462ns（模型量化/input-jitter warning保留），
+  IO→CTRL间隔106.293ns，4路RDY缺一不得放行，任一路RDY丢失、注入lock loss/外部reset
+  均立即关门。没有模拟真实传感器或将仿真当作板端校准验收。
+- 本机 FL0214 REV1.0 p6 明确25MHz，和 sensor_table.h 0136=0x19一致；Sony IMX214
+  Software Reference 0.0.6 pp47–49给双PLL公式，现有030D=8、030E/F=110、030B=1推得
+  OPCK343.75MHz、DCK171.875MHz。新XDC仅写四个名义HS primary clocks，未凭0820 requested
+  link bitrate、30FPS或网上另一版24MHz手册猜时钟。实物振荡器/偏斜/链路延时仍需有据签收。
+  本机 `CD/原理图/fl0214_2018-3-14.pdf` p4再次核对X1 OSC25MHz→U12 5PB1102PGGI→
+  两CSI MCLK，但无晶振具体BOM/ppm和PCB走线时延，未据此编造绝对IO延迟。
+- 真实旧 routed DCP 检查四 VDMA URAM均NONE/NONE；六组未驱动cascade共1424输入，
+  已用限定hier/path/driver检查的tie0验证令REQP-1869从48降为0。已有DBITERR/EN/SBITERR
+  的GND仅验证不覆盖。最初少 `-hier` 的尝试未真连通，日志保留；修正后验证实际net和真实DRC，
+  不以Tcl命令条数假称修复。RTSTAT64 nets含DONT_TOUCH/受保护vendor内部，保留真实限制，
+  不降低DRC、不强行改安全属性、不改变VDMA模式/深度/位宽或删除功能负载。
+- 正式 p0-run04 真正 validate_bd_design 通过并进入OOC/主综合；实际BD/原件/私有patch/XCI
+  审计通过（原117、HIL4、原31常规XCI489类差异保持）。最终实现/时序/DRC结果以本轮证据为准。
+  本轮未SSH、加载PL、装卸driver、改PS/网络/SD、重启、安装工具或接FMC/舵机/SW1。
+- **最终真构建**：p0-run04从私有新源完整validate→OOC/main synth→place/route→bit/XSA，
+  Vivado exit0（15:42:51结束），没有把旧DCP重新计时或旧bit改名当本次产物。
+  物理审计exit0：仅一个MMCM M6/D1/O4，14CTRL同ref_raw/同reset_hold[39]，16DELAY
+  TIME/301.056MHz/20ps/同reset_hold[7]；四路RDY AND覆盖全部14CTRL。实际ipshared四个
+  供综合HDL逐字节匹配exact patch，CSI3 OOC日志明确新301.055970参数，其他同配置缓存复用。
+- **实际签核仍失败**：WNS−1.986/TNS−146.397（92 setup/recovery endpoints），WHS−.121/
+  THS−.126（2hold）；WPWS+.012、0pulse failure，参考问题确实修复。名义MIPI模型下no_clock=0/
+  internal unconstrained=0，仍缺input20/output8；不能把旧未覆盖CSI的+.548WNS当纯性能对照。
+  CDC仍44 Critical（既有clockdet/FIFO和新增ready/reset均有），未用ASYNC_REG属性冒充关闭。
+- 最差旧clockdet跨域recovery：CSI2 clk_fail_count[5]→count_value[0]/CLR −1.986；
+  新ready_release[2]→CSI0 ready_byte[0]/CLR −1.950；byte→PL0 clockdet/ext_clk_lat −1.788，
+  FIFO ready单级跨域也失败。CSI0/3 ISERDES内部DIV4→bytealign捕获hold−.121/−.005。
+  下一步需真正重构局部CDC/reset并审查SERDES时钟偏斜，有据后定向约束/实现；本轮不仓促豁免或再全构建。
+- 全新routed及最终DRC均只剩RTSTAT-10一条/60net；REQP48确实归零。hook实际删0，
+  不能把64→60归功于脚本。保留vendor受保护网络和零DRC打包门禁。
+- packager真执行exit1拒绝timing；新repair profile另加强真实CDC必须0 Critical门禁，实际独立
+  调用也拒绝44 Critical。8项安全回归+1项私有源码篡改拒绝测试通过，Python编译通过；未重跑旧HIL大批仿真。
+- 本地诊断bit12709560B，SHA256 `7b857d653a382208ad0c5b616cde9d4e7abf3d480f9a7c78ea7e158eb0aa6e6e`；
+  XSA2363733B，SHA256 `481963326c34ef5de7fc010755ccca485ac74596050c673cc274d44b87d45941`。
+  XSA内唯一bit逐字节匹配外部新bit。二者仅在 `F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-p0-run04` 本地保留，
+  均UNSAFE/NOT DEPLOYABLE；无bin/tar/部署包，没有上板。完整证据在evidence/p0-2020.1。

+## P0 结构续作：clkdet/FIFO/reference CDC 与 SERDES（评论6247649307）
+
+- 全文读取Citlali6最新评论，沿用原分支/PR18和干净基线bf11ac222685c812c6813794959898a8c3e61d59；
+  重读AGENTS/工作流/日志/interface/个人规范，origin/main6b1c900只读核查，不切main或重排历史。
+  用户授权本轮PC离线dev/test/build/commit/push；未开始Issue20或任何上板操作。
+- v3 exact patch仅改实验副本7文件（6HDL+component.xml），原117相机归档和4继承HIL不变。
+  clkdet采用真实byte heartbeat FF、3级XPM入PL0、注册missing及3级目的byte同步释放；
+  RDY各自同步ref再注册qualification，应用复用单一目标reset后等64byte周期。
+  FIFO用真实local linkreset清空、3级ready跨域及busy/full/empty门控，stream reset下valid/read为0；
+  原4096x42 auto/FWFT保持。BUFGCE_DIV CLR在undivided HS同步，SERDES同CLK/CLK_B net局部反相1。
+- 单CSI真实局部综合首轮因重复reset同步器有2条CDC11，修后0Critical；加入完整linkreset
+  FIFOflush再综合仍0Critical（CDC3 Info4/CDC9 Info3）。局部top不能冒称整机44→0签收。
+- 可复现XSim最终PASS：电源reset、MMCM失锁/重锁、RDY延迟/丢失、byte停高/停低/重启、
+  64cycle资格、busy/full/empty/背压/stream reset；实际XPMFIFO自检旧数据清空、新数据恢复及
+  over/underflow。既有HIL100行testbench STOP/watchdog真实PASS，未改继承RTL；xelab timescale处理。
+- 附加SIM_ASSERT_CHK1运行有S4/S5/S6/S7错误，不冒称clean；S5真实为跨域rd_pntr一周期相等

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Audit camera provenance and, optionally, a generated unified BD. No Vivado/board IO."""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+CAMERA = HERE.parent / 'camera_hw'
+BD = Path('mipi_dp.srcs/sources_1/bd/design_1/design_1.bd')
+BASE = 0xa1000000
+CLOCK_HZ = 200703980
+
+
+def require(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        raise ValueError(message)
+
+
+def sha(path):
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+
+
+def size(value):
+    suffix = value[-1].upper()
+    return int(value[:-1]) * {'K': 1024, 'M': 1024**2, 'G': 1024**3}[suffix]
+
+
+def read_bd(path):
+    return json.loads(path.read_text())['design']
+
+
+def segments(design):
+    return design['addressing']['/zynq_ultra_ps_e_0']['address_spaces']['Data']['segments']
+
+
+def value(component, name):
+    return component['parameters'][name]['value']
+
+
+def source_audit():
+    manifest = json.loads((CAMERA / 'manifest.json').read_text())
+    for name, expected in manifest['sha256'].items():
+        require(sha(CAMERA / name) == expected, 'camera archive changed: ' + name)
+    origin = json.loads((HERE / 'provenance.json').read_text())
+    for entry in origin['files']:
+        require(sha(HERE / entry['target']) == entry['sha256'],
+                'inherited PR #13 file changed: ' + entry['target'])
+    design = read_bd(CAMERA / 'project' / BD)
+    ps = design['components']['zynq_ultra_ps_e_0']
+    for name, expected in [('PSU__USE__M_AXI_GP0', '1'),
+                           ('PSU__MAXIGP0__DATA_WIDTH', '128'),
+                           ('PSU__USE__S_AXI_GP3', '1'),
+                           ('PSU__SAXIGP3__DATA_WIDTH', '128')]:
+        require(value(ps, name) == expected, 'wrong archived PS profile: ' + name)
+    require(value(design['components']['ps8_0_axi_periph'], 'NUM_MI') == '11',
+            'wrong archived interconnect')
+    banks = segments(design)
+    for name, bank in banks.items():
+        low = int(bank['offset'], 16)
+        require(low + size(bank['range']) <= BASE or low >= BASE + 4096,
+                'AHIL address collides with ' + name)
+    return dict(camera_files_verified=len(manifest['sha256']),
+                inherited_files_verified=len(origin['files']),
+                inherited_pr=origin['pr'], inherited_commit=origin['commit'],
+                camera_addresses={name: dict(offset=b['offset'], range=b['range'])
+                                  for name, b in banks.items()},
+                new_hil=dict(base=hex(BASE), size=4096, clock_hz=CLOCK_HZ),
+                ip_vlnv=sorted({c['vlnv'] for c in design['components'].values()}),
+                tool_required='strict archive: 2020.2; explicit isolated experimental route: 2020.1',
+                validation='source inspection only; not Vivado validation')
+
+
+def connected(design, kind, endpoints, field):
+    wanted = set(endpoints)
+    return any(wanted <= set(net[field]) for net in design[kind].values())
+
+
+def build_audit(build):
+    old = read_bd(CAMERA / 'project' / BD)
+    new = read_bd(build / 'source' / BD)
+    native = (build / 'reconstruction.json').exists()
+    profile = 'camera-hil-2020.2'
+    adaptations = []
+    csi_patched = set()
+    if native:
+        record = json.loads((build / 'reconstruction.json').read_text())
+        require(record['profile'] == 'experimental-camera-hil-2020.1' and
+                record['tool'] == '2020.1', 'unrecognized reconstruction record')
+        require(sha(build / 'rebuild.tcl') == record['prepared_script_sha256'],
+                'experimental Tcl changed after preparation')
+        require(sha(build / 'source' / BD) == sha(build / 'vivado' / BD),
+                'audited BD snapshot differs from the actual native project BD')
+        require((build / 'validated.txt').read_text().strip() ==
+                'Vivado 2020.1 validate_bd_design returned successfully',
+                'actual 2020.1 BD validation evidence missing')
+        for name in ['grasp_fsm.sv', 'hand_hil_axi.sv', 'hand_hil_shell.v']:
+            require(sha(build / 'hil_rtl' / name) == sha(HERE / 'rtl' / name),
+                    'experimental inherited HIL source changed: ' + name)
+        profile = record['profile']
+        if 'csi_repair' in record:
+            from experimental_2020_1.csi_patch import verify_patches
+            repair = record['csi_repair']
+            require(repair['version'] == 3 and repair['input_hz'] == CLOCK_HZ and
+                    repair['output_hz'] == 301055970 and repair['multiplier'] == 6 and
+                    repair['divider'] == 4 and repair['reference_reset_cycles'] == 32,
+                    'unexpected CSI reference repair')
+            csi_patched = verify_patches(CAMERA, build, repair['changes'])
+            require(sha(build / 'csi_delay_reference.v') == repair['shared_reference_sha256'] ==
+                    sha(HERE / 'experimental_2020_1/csi_delay_reference.v'), 'shared reference RTL changed')
+            require(sha(build / 'mipi_nominal.xdc') == repair['nominal_mipi_xdc_sha256'] ==
+                    sha(HERE / 'experimental_2020_1/mipi_nominal.xdc'), 'nominal MIPI constraints changed')
+            require(sha(build / 'fix_netlist.tcl') == repair['netlist_hook_sha256'] ==
+                    sha(HERE / 'experimental_2020_1/fix_netlist.tcl'), 'netlist repair hook changed')
+            packed = {}
+            for row in repair['changes']:
+                if Path(row['path']).suffix not in ['.v', '.vhd']:
+                    continue
+                hits = list((build / 'vivado' / BD.parent / 'ipshared').rglob(Path(row['path']).name))
+                require(len(hits) == 1 and sha(hits[0]) == row['patched_sha256'],
+                        'actual packed/synthesized CSI HDL differs: ' + row['path'])
+                packed[str(hits[0])] = sha(hits[0])
+            adaptations.append(dict(csi_repair=repair, packed_csi_hdl_sha256=packed,
+                                    risk='offline experimental; sensor timing/board acceptance required'))
+    manifest = json.loads((CAMERA / 'manifest.json').read_text())
+    for name, expected in manifest['sha256'].items():
+        if name.startswith('project/repo/') or (name.startswith('project/') and
+                                                Path(name).suffix in ['.v', '.xdc']):
+            if Path(name).relative_to('project').as_posix() in csi_patched:
+                continue  # Exact original->private patched bytes already recomputed above.
+            require(sha(build / 'source' / Path(name).relative_to('project')) == expected,
+                    'copied camera HDL/constraints/IP source changed: ' + name)
+    require(old['interface_ports'] == new['interface_ports'], 'camera external ports changed')
+    for name, component in old['components'].items():
+        require(name in new['components'], 'camera block missing: ' + name)
+        target = new['components'][name]
+        require(target['vlnv'] == component['vlnv'], 'camera IP version changed: ' + name)
+        for key, parameter in component.get('parameters', {}).items():
+            expected = '12' if name == 'ps8_0_axi_periph' and key == 'NUM_MI' else parameter['value']
+            if native and name == 'zynq_ultra_ps_e_0' and key == 'PSU__PROTECTION__SLAVES':
+                actual = value(target, key).split('|')
+                original = expected.split('|')
+                extra = {'FPD;FPD_GPV;FD700000;FD7FFFFF;1',
+                         'FPD;CCI_GPV;FD6E0000;FD6EFFFF;1'}
+                require(set(actual) == set(original) | extra and len(actual) == len(original) + 2,
+                        'unexpected PS protection-table change')
+                adaptations.append(dict(block=name, parameter=key, added=sorted(extra),
+                                        risk='tool-derived XSA metadata; never execute new PS initialization'))
+                continue
+            require(value(target, key) == expected, 'camera parameter changed: ' + name + '/' + key)
+    expected_new = {'hil', 'delay_reference'} if csi_patched else {'hil'}
+    require(set(new['components']) == set(old['components']) | expected_new, 'unexpected new BD blocks')
+    if csi_patched:
+        require(new['components']['delay_reference']['vlnv'] == 'xilinx.com:module_ref:csi_delay_reference:1.0',
+                'unexpected delay reference module')
+        for endpoints in [['zynq_ultra_ps_e_0/pl_clk0', 'delay_reference/clk_pl0'],
+                          ['proc_sys_reset_100M/peripheral_reset', 'delay_reference/reset']]:
+            require(connected(new, 'nets', endpoints, 'ports'), 'shared reference input missing')
+        for shared, port in [('refclk', 'delay_refclock'), ('io_reset', 'io_reset'),

+    expected_interfaces.append(frozenset(['ps8_0_axi_periph/M11_AXI', 'hil/s_axi']))
+    actual_interfaces = [frozenset(net['interface_ports']) for net in new['interface_nets'].values()]

+    require(connected(new, 'interface_nets', ['ps8_0_axi_periph/M11_AXI', 'hil/s_axi'], 'interface_ports'),

+# Vivado 2020.2: -mode batch -source build.tcl -tclargs NEW_DIR ?generate|synth|impl?
+# Extend a private copy of the archived camera BD; never upgrade IP or touch PS.
+if {[version -short] ne "2020.2"} {
+    error "Unified camera/HIL requires Vivado 2020.2 (camera original: 2020.2_AR75986). No downgrade/upgrade is permitted."
+}
+if {$argc < 1 || $argc > 2} {error "usage: build.tcl NEW_DIR ?generate|synth|impl?"}
+set out [file normalize [lindex $argv 0]]
+set stage [expr {$argc == 2 ? [lindex $argv 1] : "generate"}]
+if {$stage ni {generate synth impl}} {error "invalid stage: $stage"}
+if {[file exists $out]} {error "Refusing existing output directory: $out"}
+set here [file normalize [file dirname [info script]]]
+set root [file normalize [file join $here ../..]]
+set camera [file join $root fpga camera_hw]
+set live_hz 200703980
+# The original script deliberately creates only a new isolated camera project.
+set saved_argv $argv
+set saved_argc $argc
+set argv [list $out]
+set argc 1
+source [file join $camera scripts create_project.tcl]
+set argv $saved_argv
+set argc $saved_argc
+foreach name {grasp_fsm.sv hand_hil_axi.sv hand_hil_shell.v} {
+    add_files -norecurse [file join $here rtl $name]
+}
+update_compile_order -fileset sources_1
+set bd [get_files design_1.bd]
+open_bd_design $bd
+report_ip_status -file [file join $out ip_status.rpt]
+foreach ip [get_ips] {
+    if {[get_property IS_LOCKED $ip]} {
+        error "Locked IP: $ip. Use the matching 2020.2/AR75986 environment; never auto-upgrade."
+    }
+}
+set ps [get_bd_cells zynq_ultra_ps_e_0]
+foreach {key expected} {
+    PSU__USE__M_AXI_GP0 1 PSU__MAXIGP0__DATA_WIDTH 128
+    PSU__USE__S_AXI_GP3 1 PSU__SAXIGP3__DATA_WIDTH 128
+    PSU__CRL_APB__PL0_REF_CTRL__FREQMHZ 200
+    PSU__CRL_APB__PL1_REF_CTRL__FREQMHZ 100
+} {
+    if {[get_property CONFIG.$key $ps] != $expected} {error "Unexpected camera PS: $key"}
+}
+set bus [get_bd_cells ps8_0_axi_periph]
+if {[get_property CONFIG.NUM_MI $bus] != 11} {error "Unexpected camera interconnect"}
+# Append one AXI4-Lite destination. The interconnect supplies width/protocol
+# conversion from the unchanged 128-bit HPM master. Existing M00..M10 stay wired.
+set_property CONFIG.NUM_MI 12 $bus
+create_bd_cell -type module -reference hand_hil_shell hil
+set_property CONFIG.CLK_HZ $live_hz [get_bd_cells hil]
+connect_bd_intf_net [get_bd_intf_pins ps8_0_axi_periph/M11_AXI] [get_bd_intf_pins hil/s_axi]
+connect_bd_net [get_bd_pins zynq_ultra_ps_e_0/pl_clk0] [get_bd_pins hil/clk] [get_bd_pins ps8_0_axi_periph/M11_ACLK]
+connect_bd_net [get_bd_pins proc_sys_reset_100M/peripheral_aresetn] [get_bd_pins hil/rst_n] [get_bd_pins ps8_0_axi_periph/M11_ARESETN]
+set bank [get_bd_addr_segs -of_objects [get_bd_intf_pins hil/s_axi]]
+if {[llength $bank] != 1} {error "Expected a single AHIL register bank"}
+# Only this new segment is assigned. Do not auto-assign the camera address map.
+assign_bd_address -offset 0xA1000000 -range 4K -target_address_space [get_bd_addr_spaces zynq_ultra_ps_e_0/Data] $bank
+validate_bd_design
+save_bd_design
+write_bd_tcl [file join $out camera_hil_bd.tcl]
+# Reuse the original wrapper (external ports unchanged); all products are copies.
+generate_target all $bd
+update_compile_order -fileset sources_1
+if {$stage ne "generate"} {
+    launch_runs synth_1 -jobs 4
+    wait_on_run synth_1
+    if {[get_property PROGRESS [get_runs synth_1]] ne "100%"} {error "synthesis failed"}
+    open_run synth_1
+    report_utilization -file [file join $out utilization_synth.rpt]
+    close_design
+}
+if {$stage eq "impl"} {
+    # Time the whole preserved camera design at the clocks the current FSBL
+    # actually supplies. This changes timing constraints, never PS registers.
+    set timing_xdc [file join $out live_clock.xdc]
+    set handle [open $timing_xdc w]
+    puts $handle {set src [get_pins -hier -filter {REF_PIN_NAME == pl_clk0}]}
+    puts $handle {if {[llength $src] != 1} {error "Expected one PS PL0 source"}}
+    puts $handle "create_clock -name clk_pl_0 -period [expr {1.0e9/$live_hz}] \$src"
+    puts $handle {set src [get_pins -hier -filter {REF_PIN_NAME == pl_clk1}]}
+    puts $handle {if {[llength $src] != 1} {error "Expected one PS PL1 source"}}
+    # Both reference clocks share the preserved RPLL and 2:1 divisors.
+    puts $handle "create_clock -name clk_pl_1 -period [expr {2.0e9/$live_hz}] \$src"
+    close $handle
+    add_files -fileset constrs_1 -norecurse $timing_xdc
+    set_property USED_IN_SYNTHESIS false [get_files $timing_xdc]
+    set_property PROCESSING_ORDER LATE [get_files $timing_xdc]
+    launch_runs impl_1 -to_step write_bitstream -jobs 4
+    wait_on_run impl_1
+    if {[get_property PROGRESS [get_runs impl_1]] ne "100%"} {error "implementation failed"}
+    open_run impl_1
+    report_timing_summary -report_unconstrained -file [file join $out timing_impl.rpt]
+    report_drc -file [file join $out drc_impl.rpt]
+    report_methodology -file [file join $out methodology_impl.rpt]
+    write_hw_platform -fixed -include_bit [file join $out camera_hil.xsa]
+}
+puts "CAMERA_HIL_DONE stage=$stage output=$out (no hardware access)"

+# Real 2020.1 reconstruction and remaining signoff blockers
+
+The user authorized only the installed 2020.1 tools; no 2020.2 installation is
+required. This experiment changes neither the archived camera nor the board.
+[result.json](result.json) records commands, raw-file paths/SHA256, archived-text
+SHA256, source/BD/XCI audit, binary artifacts and unperformed work. Text copies
+here use LF and omit trailing line padding; the unmodified raw files remain at
+the recorded local paths. No bit/XSA/bin is uploaded to GitHub.
+
+| Actual step | Result |
+| --- | --- |
+| Native catalog/property probe | All original IP definitions available; 32 IP up to date/included, 0 locked; 1,012 PS properties restored |
+| Combined BD | Actual validate_bd_design succeeds: 32 original blocks + AHIL; original connections/addresses preserved |
+| Synthesis | OOC and main synthesis succeed; main has 0 critical warnings/errors; Synthesis license acquired |
+| Implementation | Placement/routing/bitgen/XSA creation complete, exit 0; Implementation license acquired |
+| Clock correction | Unique original PS8 leaf sources proven; same routed DCP reanalysed, exit 0; no corrected implementation rerun |
+| Timing/coverage | **Fails**: WNS +0.548 ns, WHS +0.010 ns, WPWS -1.649 ns; 14 pulse-width failures; uncovered paths below |
+| DRC | **49 warnings**, 0 errors: REQP-1869 ×48, RTSTAT-10 ×1 |
+| Safe packaging | **Refuses** actual 2020.1 result for failed timing, exit 1; no bin/tar/runtime package created |
+| Board operations | None; no combined-profile video, HIL, STOP, watchdog or rollback tested |
+
+The first `run01` used general Tcl `if` statements in XDC (unsupported by 2020.1)
+and selected two hierarchical aliases for each clock. Its exact generated
+[rebuild-executed.tcl](rebuild-executed.tcl), [log](run01-vivado.txt) and binary
+hashes are preserved; it is a diagnostic artifact, not an accepted build.
+The current `prepare.py` puts assertions in ordinary Tcl and reuses original
+clock SOURCE_PINS, so fresh output includes that fix. That full fresh path was
+not rerun through all OOC/implementation merely to repeat known blockers.
+
+The executed [repair Tcl](repair-clock-executed.tcl) opens successful synthesis
+using only the original constraints, proves each original clock has one leaf
+source, then reanalyses the **same real routed DCP** with the corrected
+[live clock constraints](repaired-live-clock.xdc). It does not rerun placement,
+routing or bitgen in `diagnose` mode. [report_clocks](clock-diagnose-clocks.rpt)
+and [clock_sources](clock-sources.txt) prove one source per PL0/PL1, at
+4.982/9.965 ns (full constraint values 4.982462231192426/9.964924462384852 ns).
+The [corrected-clock timing report](clock-diagnose-timing.rpt) still fails.
+During the subsequent optional report_methodology, Vivado rereads the original
+failed XDC stored with the checkpoint and logs its old two-source warning;
+the clocks/timing/DRC files above were emitted **before** that call. Do not
+interpret this diagnosis as a clean reimplementation or corrected candidate bit.
+
+## Concrete remaining problems
+
+1. **IDELAYCTRL reference mismatch.** The actual report requires maximum REFCLK
+   period 3.333 ns; the preserved PL0-derived reference is 4.982 ns. The 14
+   failing pins include
+   `design_1_i/csi_4lane_raw10_3/inst/csi_rx_4lane_m0/link/gen_idctl.idctrl/gen_us.delayctrl/REFCLK`
+   and tool-replicated controllers in other banks/cameras. The original BD
+   connects all `csi_4lane_raw10_N/ref_clock_in` to PS PL0. Supplied
+   `csi_rx_idelayctrl_gen.vhd:34–40` instantiates IDELAYCTRL on that reference;
+   `csi_rx_hs_lane_phy.vhd:75` sets IDELAYE3 REFCLK_FREQUENCY to 200.0. No
+   configuration was changed to make this mismatch disappear.
+2. **Incomplete sensor/CSI timing constraints.** Both real timing reports show
+   no_clock=2,496, unconstrained_internal_endpoints=6,036, missing input delays=24,
+   missing output delays=8. Original XDC supplies pin/IO/IDELAY groups but does
+   not supply a complete external MIPI clock/input timing model. Setup/hold
+   slack on constrained PL0 paths is not signoff for these uncovered paths.
+3. **Native URAM warnings.** 48 REQP-1869 checks concern the four VDMA S2MM
+   linebuffer URAM cascade inputs (ADDR/BWE/DIN/DOUT/RDACCESS/RDB_WR buses,
+   four VDMAs × two ports × six groups) that the tool says should be tied low
+   for CASCADE_ORDER NONE/FIRST.
+   No VDMA depth/mode, primitive tie-off or rule severity was changed here.
+4. **Unroutable-load warning.** RTSTAT-10 reports 64 nets with no routable loads,
+   including dbg_hub FIFO status/overflow and AXI downsizer FIFO status signals.
+   The [full DRC report](clock-diagnose-drc.rpt) names the nets. They were not
+   deleted or waived to satisfy a zero-DRC package check.
+
+These are observed in this 2020.1 implementation. Without a 2020.2 comparison,
+they do not prove a downgrade-specific defect or establish that the archived
+source would meet signoff in 2020.2. The old fixed-hash camera bit's real video
+success is a separate fact; that original bit/XSA/source stays untouched.
+
+The smallest next design work is to evaluate a compliant **PL-local** reference
+for IDELAYCTRL, with matching CSI delay/reference parameters and reset/CDC
+handling while retaining PS/DDR initialization and the camera ABI. That needs
+an explicit design delta and timing check, not changing PL0 to a guessed value.
+Complete sensor mode/lane clock, IO delay and board skew information is also
+needed to write defensible MIPI constraints. Only after those timing issues
+are resolved should a narrowly proved unused-URAM tie-off/no-load cleanup be
+considered, followed by one fresh native implementation and the existing
+strict package gates. This needs no large tool installation. It does require
+design review and separately authorized camera/board acceptance; no new MMCM
+or such hardware experiment was attempted in this round.
+
+## Reproduction
+
+For a fresh isolated native build use
+[experimental_2020_1/README.md](../../experimental_2020_1/README.md).
+The exact first-run commands are in result.json. The correction diagnosis was:
+
+```powershell
+& F:/Xilinx/Vivado/2020.1/bin/vivado.bat -mode batch -nojournal -log F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-clock-diagnose01.log -source fpga/camera_hil/experimental_2020_1/repair_clock.tcl -tclargs F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-run01 F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-clock-diagnose01 diagnose
+```
+
+Result paths must be new. `impl` may replace `diagnose` for a separately
+requested full corrected implementation; that mode was **not run here**.
+Package acceptance still requires zero DRC violations, passing timing/coverage,
+unique live-clock sources, preserved topology and exact bit/XSA correspondence.
+The old camera/HIL standalone profiles remain the known recovery references;
+switching between them is not simultaneous operation and was not done here.

+# Preserve the original experiment and create a separate implementation run.
+# -source repair_clock.tcl -tclargs ORIGINAL_BUILD NEW_REPORT_DIR ?diagnose|impl?
+# No reset_runs, IP edits, constraint overwrites, PS init or hardware access.
+if {[version -short] ne "2020.1" || $argc < 2 || $argc > 3} {error "Requires 2020.1 and ORIGINAL_BUILD NEW_REPORT_DIR ?diagnose|impl?"}
+set build [file normalize [lindex $argv 0]]
+set result [file normalize [lindex $argv 1]]
+set stage [expr {$argc == 3 ? [lindex $argv 2] : "diagnose"}]
+if {$stage ni {diagnose impl}} {error "Expected diagnose or impl"}
+if {[file exists $result]} {error "Refusing existing result directory"}
+file mkdir $result
+file copy [file normalize [info script]] [file join $result repair_clock_executed.tcl]
+open_project [file join $build vivado mipi_dp.xpr]
+if {[get_property PROGRESS [get_runs synth_1]] ne "100%"} {error "Successful original synthesis required"}
+# Select a fresh constraint set before opening the synthesized netlist, so the
+# failed attempt's live_clock.xdc is never applied during source discovery.
+set constrset [expr {$stage eq "diagnose" ? "clock_diagnose" : "live_clock_fixed"}]
+set run [expr {$stage eq "diagnose" ? "diagnose_liveclock" : "impl_liveclock"}]
+create_fileset -constrset $constrset
+foreach name {system.xdc mipi.xdc QSFP.xdc ddr4_set.xdc mipi2.xdc} {
+    add_files -fileset $constrset -norecurse [file join $build source mipi_dp.srcs constrs_1 new $name]
+}
+create_run $run -parent_run synth_1 -flow {Vivado Implementation 2020} -strategy {Vivado Implementation Defaults} -constrset $constrset
+current_run -implementation [get_runs $run]
+open_run synth_1
+set xdc [file join $result live_clock_single_source.xdc]
+set f [open $xdc w]
+foreach index {0 1} {
+    set period [expr {1.0e9 * (1 + $index) / 200703980}]
+    set clk [get_clocks clk_pl_$index]
+    set sources [get_property SOURCE_PINS $clk]
+    # Read the original PS clock, before adding the new constraint set.
+    if {[llength $clk] != 1 || [llength $sources] != 1} {error "Expected original single-source PS clock $index: $sources"}
+    puts "ORIGINAL_CLOCK_SOURCE clk_pl_$index $sources"
+    puts $f "create_clock -name clk_pl_$index -period $period \[get_pins \{$sources\}\]"
+}
+close $f
+close_design
+add_files -fileset $constrset -norecurse $xdc
+set_property USED_IN_SYNTHESIS false [get_files $xdc]
+set_property PROCESSING_ORDER LATE [get_files $xdc]
+if {$stage eq "impl"} {
+    launch_runs $run -to_step write_bitstream -jobs 4
+    wait_on_run $run
+    if {[get_property PROGRESS [get_runs $run]] ne "100%"} {error "Corrected-clock implementation failed"}
+    open_run $run
+} else {
+    open_checkpoint [file join $build vivado mipi_dp.runs impl_1 design_1_wrapper_routed.dcp]
+    read_xdc $xdc
+}
+report_clocks -file [file join $result clocks_impl.rpt]
+set f [open [file join $result clock_sources.txt] w]
+foreach index {0 1} {
+    set clk [get_clocks clk_pl_$index]
+    if {[llength $clk] != 1 || [llength [get_property SOURCE_PINS $clk]] != 1} {error "Final PL clock must have one source"}
+    puts $f "clk_pl_$index\t[get_property PERIOD $clk]\t[get_property SOURCE_PINS $clk]"
+}
+close $f
+report_timing_summary -report_unconstrained -file [file join $result timing_impl.rpt]
+report_drc -file [file join $result drc_impl.rpt]
+report_methodology -file [file join $result methodology_impl.rpt]
+if {$stage eq "impl"} {
+    write_hw_platform -fixed -include_bit [file join $result camera_hil.xsa]
+    set f [open [file join $result implementation.json] w]
+    puts $f "\{\"build\":\"$build\",\"implementation_run\":\"impl_liveclock\",\"repair\":\"single-source live clocks; no IP or PS edits\"\}"
+} else {
+    set f [open [file join $result diagnosis.json] w]
+    puts $f "\{\"build\":\"$build\",\"stage\":\"routed DCP reanalysis only\",\"implementation_rerun\":false,\"corrected_bit_created\":false\}"
+}
+close $f
+puts "REPAIRED_CLOCK_DONE stage=$stage; no board validation"

+# P0 native 2020.1 repair: UNSAFE / NOT DEPLOYABLE
+
+The [P0 request](https://github.com/Tom-mr33/AmazingHand-based-on-FPGA/issues/17#issuecomment-6246782620)
+was implemented in a new private project, `F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-p0-run04`.
+Actual BD validation, OOC/main synthesis, placement, routing, bitgen and XSA
+export complete with Vivado 2020.1, exit 0. This is a fresh implementation of
+the new source/constraints, not another timing-only analysis of the old bit.
+The [machine-readable result](result.json) contains raw paths/hashes, commands,
+source/BD/packed-HDL audit and diagnostic artifact SHA256. No binaries or full
+Sony/module manuals are uploaded to GitHub.
+
+| Check | Actual result |
+| --- | --- |
+| Original archive / inherited HIL | 117 / 4 files unchanged |
+| BD | Original 32 blocks + AHIL + one shared delay reference; original endpoint groups/addresses preserved |
+| Physical reference | One MMCM M6/D1/O4; 14 IDELAYCTRLs on `ref_raw`, all reset by the same `reset_hold_reg[39]/Q` |
+| Physical delay elements | 16 TIME-mode IDELAYE3, REFCLK_FREQUENCY 301.056 MHz, delay 20 ps, common I/O reset `[7]/Q` |
+| RDY aggregation | Actual return AND trees include all 14 controllers (2 + 4 + 4 + 4); absent sensor clocks do not gate calibration reset |
+| Reference pulse checks | **Fixed:** WPWS +0.012 ns, 0 failing pulse endpoints (old diagnostic: 14 failures) |
+| Setup/recovery | **Fails:** WNS -1.986 ns / TNS -146.397 ns, 92 failing endpoints |
+| Hold | **Fails:** WHS -0.121 ns / THS -0.126 ns, 2 failing endpoints |
+| Timing coverage | Under nominal MIPI clock model: no_clock=0, unconstrained_internal_endpoints=0; **20 input / 8 output delays still missing** |
+| DRC | **REQP-1869 48 -> 0**; RTSTAT-10 remains 1 warning / 60 nets, 0 errors |
+| CDC | **44 Critical findings**, 64 Warning, 19 Info; includes old and new crossings below |
+| Packaging | Actual CLI exit 1: `UNIFIED_PACKAGE_REFUSED: timing constraints failed`; separate CDC gate also rejects 44 Critical findings |
+| Board | **Not tested:** no new PL load, SSH state changes, driver operations, SD/PS initialization or simultaneous camera/HIL acceptance |
+
+The measured PS clock remains unchanged; M6/D1/O4 physically derives
+301.055970 MHz from 200.703980 MHz. The actual tool reports quantized periods
+(PL0 4.982 ns, reference about 3.321 ns), slightly faster than the exact source
+constraint. Physical inspection is in [physical-reference.txt](physical-reference.txt),
+with the [executed inspection Tcl](review-impl-executed.tcl). It changes no netlist
+or timing constraints. Simulation separately verifies reset ordering, >106 ns
+I/O-to-controller separation, all-four-RDY requirement, external reset and injected
+lock-loss assertion; it is not hardware BISC acceptance.
+
+## Remaining violations and minimum next work
+
+The old WNS +0.548 ns excluded thousands of undefined-clock endpoints. The new
+negative WNS includes nominal sensor-clock and reset crossings, so these values
+must not be presented as a simple performance regression. See the complete
+[timing](timing_impl.rpt), [coverage](coverage_details.rpt), [CDC](cdc_impl.rpt)
+and categorized [violating paths](violating-paths.json).
+
+1. **Original clock detector and FIFO CDC.** Worst recovery -1.986 ns is CSI2
+   `clkdet/clk_fail_count_reg[5]/C -> count_value_reg[0]/CLR` (PL0 -> byte clock).
+   Setup -1.788 ns is CSI0 byte-clock output -> `clkdet/ext_clk_lat_reg/D`;
+   `fifo_ready_reg -> fifo_ready_maxis_reg/D` also fails (single-stage crossing).
+   Minimum repair: a reviewed clock-presence/reset-release synchronizer and
+   genuine two-stage ready transfer, with focused fault/clock-stop tests.
+2. **New ready/reset crossings are not signed off.** For example,
+   `delay_reference/ready_release_reg[2]/C -> CSI0 ready_byte_reg[0]/CLR`
+   fails recovery by -1.950 ns; application counters and PHY reset synchronizers
+   also appear in CDC/recovery reports. Shared bank-safe primitive sequencing
+   is implemented, but adding ASYNC_REG alone does not close reset-domain CDC.
+   Minimum repair: evaluate XPM asynchronous-reset structures, combine reset
+   causes deliberately, release application logic only in its byte domain, and
+   justify any narrowly scoped first-stage exception. No broad clock groups or
+   false paths were added to make these findings disappear.
+3. **SERDES capture hold.** CSI0 `d0phy/gen_us.ideser/RX_DIV4_CLK_Q ->
+   gen_bytealign[0].ba/curr_byte_reg[5]/D` is -0.121 ns; CSI3 corresponding path
+   is -0.005 ns. These are ISERDES internal divide-clock to external byte-clock
+   capture paths, not the IDELAY reference mismatch. Review component-mode
+   clock alignment/skew/placement against UG571 before a targeted implementation;
+   do not waive the data paths or change FIFO mode without proof.
+4. **External I/O bounds remain incomplete.** The 171.875 MHz model follows
+   existing register values and the local 25 MHz FL0214 REV1.0 / 2018-03-14
+   schematic and Sony software-reference formulas. It is not a scope measurement.
+   Missing delays cover 16 HS data inputs plus four PL AXI-IIC inputs; outputs
+   are four IIC and four camera-reset pins. Minimum inputs for signoff are the
+   actual module/oscillator part and ppm/jitter bounds, sensor output timing at
+   this mode, bridge timing and PCB/FMC trace/skew bounds, and a defensible IIC/
+   reset external interface model. Local MC20901 data alone does not bound the
+   whole link. No further wiring is needed for the present offline deliverable.
+5. **Protected vendor no-load outputs.** RTSTAT-10 now lists 60 nets (old 64),
+   but the hook actually removed **0**. Do not credit this count change to
+   cleanup. DCP attempts exposed DONT_TOUCH and security-protected debug/downsizer
+   internals; these were retained. A vendor-supported fix or an explicit future
+   exception decision is needed; this PR does not waive the rule or change the
+   zero-DRC deployment gate.
+
+Planning estimate, not a completed test: 2-4 hours for focused CDC/reset changes
+and tests, 2-4 hours for component clock/hold review plus one targeted build;
+external I/O completion depends on the missing board/mode bounds. No entire
+camera-system rewrite or Vivado 2020.2 installation is a prerequisite.
+
+## Reproduction and evidence boundaries
+
+Use [the repair command](../../experimental_2020_1/README.md), with a new output
+directory and `--repair-csi`. This round used `p0-run04`; the earlier per-CSI-MMCM
+`p0-run01` was intentionally stopped after the shared-bank reset review. `run02`
+stopped during exact source preparation; `run03` was prepared but never invoked.
+Their history is retained in result.json. None is a candidate firmware artifact.
+
+The [executed rebuild Tcl](rebuild-executed.tcl), [Vivado log](vivado.txt),
+[netlist hook](netlist-hook-executed.tcl), [hook result](netlist-repair.txt),
+[DRC](drc_impl.rpt), [clocks](clocks_impl.rpt), and exact source reconstruction
+ledger are archived here. LF copies strip trailing padding/blank EOF lines;
+result.json records both raw-local and normalized-file SHA256. Original raw
+files and diagnostic bit/XSA remain at their recorded absolute local paths.
+Original camera and standalone HIL recovery profiles remain unchanged.
+
+STOP/watchdog/session binding and the existing zero timing/DRC/coverage gates
+remain in force. The repair profile additionally requires a genuine CDC report
+with zero Critical findings. No bin/tar/deployment package was created, and no
+new firmware was loaded. Board calibration, video, HIL/STOP/watchdog/rollback
+and same-bit dual-function testing are all **not performed**.

+# Explicit experimental Vivado 2020.1 reconstruction
+
+Authorized by [Issue #17's follow-up](https://github.com/Tom-mr33/AmazingHand-based-on-FPGA/issues/17#issuecomment-6246288827).
+This route recreates the design in a **new** project from the original BD's
+configuration; it does not open an unsupported old BD and change its version,
+run upgrade_ip, overwrite any original XCI/BD, or alter the strict 2020.2 entry.
+It uses only the installed Vivado/Vitis 2020.1. No new tool installation is needed.
+
+```powershell
+python fpga/camera_hil/experimental_2020_1/prepare.py --output F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-new --stage impl --repair-csi
+& F:/Xilinx/Vivado/2020.1/bin/vivado.bat -mode batch -nojournal -log F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-new/vivado.log -source F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-new/rebuild.tcl
+python fpga/camera_hil/audit.py --build F:/ah-camera-hil-2020.1-new
+```
+
+`probe` stops after actual catalog/property restoration and IP status. `validate`
+restores the entire topology, adds AHIL, invokes real validate_bd_design and
+generates output products. `synth` and `impl` continue to their respective runs.
+Output destinations must not exist; source snapshots, generated projects and
+reports stay there. `reconstruction.json` lists every converted block and the
+exact generated Tcl hash. It is not a completion certificate. `validated.txt`
+is written by Vivado only after validation returns successfully.
+
+The 2020.1 catalog contains all original IP VLNVs and the supplied ALINX CSI and
+Digilent Bayer/Gamma sources. All 1,012 archived PS properties are accepted by
+2020.1 without removing a property. The unflagged reconstruction preserves every
+original top-level block/connection/address and appends M11/AHIL. `--repair-csi`
+also adds the explicitly audited shared-reference block and private scalar
+calibration ports described below; original endpoint groups remain connected.
+Native XCI/BD
+serialization still differs from 2020.2; these are explicitly audited:
+
+- PS `PSU__PROTECTION__SLAVES` adds the FPD_GPV and CCI_GPV descriptors. Original
+  entries/flags remain unchanged. New XSA PS initialization must never run on
+  the existing Linux: the added metadata is not board validated.
+- Address-space serialization includes 40-bit/1T PS and 64-bit/16E VDMA metadata;
+  all mapped and excluded segments retain their original values.
+- Native XCI instance names change. Metadata of disabled PS AXI interfaces and
+  the unconnected IRQ0 differs; connected HPM0/HP1 and IRQ1 stay unchanged.
+- The 2020.1 xlconcat schema omits nonexistent input slots >=32; the six used
+  inputs are unchanged. AXI-IIC advertises two outstanding accesses instead of
+  one; its core model parameters are unchanged, and camera 0 uses PS I2C0.
+- Metadata of other unconnected/disabled interfaces differs. No changed active
+  image pipeline model parameter is accepted. `audit_xci.py` rejects differences
+  outside the enumerated cases, in addition to the original BD semantic audit.
+
+The native XCI implementations require real synthesis/implementation and later
+independent board acceptance. Passing a catalog/property audit, BD validation or
+even implementation does not establish real sensor capture in this profile.
+The existing camera/HIL standalone profiles and original camera files remain
+the recovery references. No board operations are part of this experiment, and
+Issue #20 vision-to-control integration is outside its authorized scope.
+
+After an implementation truly passes the unchanged timing/DRC/coverage and
+bit/XSA gates, `package_linux.py` recognizes `experimental-camera-hil-2020.1`
+and requires matching 2020.1 reports; all firmware hashes and rollback checks
+remain mandatory. New firmware still needs separate current field approval.
+
+## P0 private CSI repair
+
+The [P0 authorization](https://github.com/Tom-mr33/AmazingHand-based-on-FPGA/issues/17#issuecomment-6246782620)
+adds `--repair-csi`. Omitting that flag reproduces the earlier reconstruction.
+The current v3 flagged path makes seven exact file transformations only in the
+copied CSI IP: six HDL files plus component.xml scalar ports/XPM metadata. `csi_patch.py` records
+original/patched SHA256 and the auditor recomputes every expected byte from
+the untouched archive. A single new `delay_reference` module is shared by all
+four CSI instances; all existing connections, addresses and PS parameters stay.
+
+- Real MMCME4_BASE M=6/D=1/O=4, BUFG feedback/output: unchanged measured PL0
+  200.703980 MHz -> VCO 1204.223880 MHz -> IDELAY reference 301.055970 MHz.
+  The original PL0 clock detector and AXI/stream domains remain on PL0.
+- TIME/FIXED IDELAYE3 retains delay=20 ps and EN_VTC=1; REFCLK_FREQUENCY
+  matches 301.055970. IDELAY reset now uses the common I/O reset instead of
+  constant zero. Original IDELAYCTRL SIM_DEVICE=ULTRASCALE is correct for US+.
+- Lock loss/reset asserts immediately; three reference-domain stages release
+  the sequencer. All I/O primitive resets release together after 8 ref cycles,
+  then all IDELAYCTRL resets together 32 ref cycles later (>106 ns).
+  Primitive initial reset release does not require a sensor/byte clock or RDY.
+  All four controller RDYs are synchronized in the common reference domain;
+  each application separately synchronizes this condition and waits at least
+  64 of its own byte clocks before accepting data. An absent camera therefore
+  does not prevent the reference-domain calibration sequence from running.
+- The v3 structural follow-up replaces clock-level sampling with a real byte-domain
+  heartbeat FF, three-stage XPM transfer to PL0, registered missing-clock state,
+  and a three-stage XPM asynchronous-assert/synchronous-release reset back to byte.
+  The timeout is 201 PL0 cycles after the last observed heartbeat transition
+  (plus observation latency), approximately 1 us, and handles stopped-high/low clocks.
+- Each controller group's RDY is separately synchronized into the reference domain,
+  then qualification is registered there before crossing to byte through one XPM
+  reset. Application logic waits 64 byte cycles; the same local link reset flushes
+  the FIFO after calibration/clock failure. No duplicate reset synchronizer can
+  release application and FIFO independently in the same domain.
+- FIFO write-ready originates in a real byte-domain register and crosses through
+  three XPM stages. Both actual FIFO busy outputs, full/empty and stream reset
+  gate transfers; AXIS valid no longer depends on sink ready. Original FIFO
+  mode/depth/width/memory selection remain unchanged.
+- BUFGCE_DIV clear releases through an XPM reset clocked by the undivided HS
+  clock. ISERDESE3 CLK and CLK_B use the same physical clock net with local
+  IS_CLK_B_INVERTED=1 per UG949. This is a real primitive connection/property
+  change, not a hold exception. Routed hold and CDC reports remain mandatory.
+- `mipi_nominal.xdc` models only the nominal source clocks derived from the
+  local FL0214 REV1.0 manual and fl0214_2018-3-14 schematic p4
+  (X1 OSC25MHz -> U12 5PB1102PGGI -> both CSI MCLK) and Sony IMX214 Software Reference
+  0.0.6 pp47-49 plus existing sensor_table.h registers: OPCK=25/8*110 MHz,
+  DCK=OPCK/2/1=171.875 MHz. It supplies no guessed external delays and no broad
+  clock-group/false-path exceptions. Sensor/bridge/PCB/oscillator qualification
+  is a separate signoff requirement; the nominal model is not a field reading.
+- `fix_netlist.tcl` proves four VDMA URAM288 NONE/NONE instances and ties only
+  disconnected cascade inputs to GND, leaving already grounded inputs alone.
+  It checks actual connections and driver types. It considers only proved
+  unused FIFO status outputs for no-load cleanup; DONT_TOUCH/security-protected
+  vendor nets are retained. No VDMA mode/depth/width, DRC severity or gate changes.
+
+The clock/reset requirements are from [DS925 I/O delay characteristics](https://docs.amd.com/r/en-US/ds925-zynq-ultrascale-plus/Input/Output-Delay-Switching-Characteristics),
+[DS925 MMCM characteristics](https://docs.amd.com/r/en-US/ds925-zynq-ultrascale-plus/MMCM-Switching-Characteristics)
+and [UG571 v1.16 pp188-194](https://docs.amd.com/api/khub/documents/kFbaUC5HGcXyGNauhgU6Gw/content).
+The local Sony/module manuals are not redistributed here. The older archived
+camera, validated firmware and strict entry are never patched by this option.
+
+
+## Structural CDC fault tests and signoff
+
+Authorized by [the structural P0 follow-up](https://github.com/Tom-mr33/AmazingHand-based-on-FPGA/issues/17#issuecomment-6247649307).
+The exact patch ledger is version 3 and rejects any unreviewed private source
+change. `csi_clock_detector.vhd`, `csi_cdc_helpers.v` and `structural_patch.py`
+are reproducible private transformations, not edits to the original camera IP.
+Vendor XPM instances supply their own narrowly scoped first-stage CDC constraints;
+no clock groups, broad false paths or manual CDC exceptions were added.
+
+```powershell
+python fpga/camera_hil/experimental_2020_1/run_local_tests.py --output F:/ah-camera-hil-faults-new
+python fpga/camera_hil/experimental_2020_1/prepare.py --output F:/ah-camera-hil-local-new --stage impl --repair-csi
+& F:/Xilinx/Vivado/2020.1/bin/vivado.bat -mode batch -nojournal -log F:/ah-camera-hil-local-new/local.log -source fpga/camera_hil/experimental_2020_1/local_verify.tcl -tclargs F:/ah-camera-hil-local-new F:/ah-camera-hil-local-synth-new
+```
+
+These tests inject initial reset, actual MMCM model loss/relock, delayed/all-RDY
+qualification, byte clock stop high/low and restart, FIFO busy/full/empty,
+backpressure, stream reset and stale-data flushing with the actual vendor FIFO.
+They do not simulate sensor electrical margins or establish live image capture.
+The actual FIFO uses the original production-default SIM_ASSERT_CHK=0 with
+independent overflow/underflow, busy and data checks. An additional diagnostic
+SIM_ASSERT_CHK=1 run emitted vendor S4/S5/S6/S7 errors and is retained separately;
+it is **not** described as a clean vendor assertion run. The S5 diagnostic is a
+one-cycle cross-domain read-pointer equality check despite its sleep wording. S4 remains an
+unresolved diagnostic, bounded by the independent busy/empty/flush self-checks.
+
+SERDES clock guidance: [UG949 ISERDESE3/IDDRE1 clocking](https://docs.amd.com/r/2021.2-English/ug949-vivado-design-methodology/ISERDESE3-and-IDDRE1-Clocking)
+and UG571 v1.16 pp190-191. No internal divide-clock fabric connection, arbitrary
+input delay, FIFO mode change or clock-frequency reduction was used.
+
+The packaging gate also requires a genuine nonnegative bus-skew report for
+XPM Gray-pointer constraints, alongside zero Critical CDC, complete timing
+coverage, timing closure, zero DRC and source/topology/bit-XSA matching.
+The [current full-implementation facts](../evidence/cdc-2020.1/README.md) show
+modeled timing met and whole-design Critical/Warning CDC zero; external timing,
+RTSTAT and frame-protocol acceptance still prevent deployment. The
+older P0 evidence remains immutable historical output.
+
+
+A remaining protocol risk is deliberately not hidden by the local FIFO tests:
+the approximately1us missing-clock threshold can also be reached during a normal
+noncontinuous MIPI HS/frame gap. Flushing on link reset may discard queued tail
+pixels under downstream backpressure. The four-word FIFO test does not establish
+complete-frame behavior. Normal HS gaps, TUSER/TLAST preservation, incomplete-frame
+handling and VDMA recovery at real frame boundaries require a focused protocol
+simulation and later separately authorized same-bit sensor test. These remain
+functional acceptance blockers even if internal timing/CDC close. No current
+claim is made that the private camera capture profile has been board validated.

+"""Compare generated 2020.1 XCI parameters with archived camera XCI, including inactive metadata."""
+import json

+import re
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+NS = '{http://www.spiritconsortium.org/XMLSchema/SPIRIT/1685-2009}'
+
+
+def values(path):
+    root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
+    return {node.attrib[NS + 'referenceId']: node.text or ''
+            for node in root.iter(NS + 'configurableElementValue')}
+
+
+def audit_xci(camera, build, old, new):
+    original = camera / 'project/mipi_dp.srcs/sources_1/bd/design_1'
+    generated = build / 'vivado/mipi_dp.srcs/sources_1/bd/design_1'
+    used = {p for net in old['interface_nets'].values() for p in net['interface_ports']}
+    used.update(p for net in old['nets'].values() for p in net['ports'])
+    report = {}
+    for name, component in old['components'].items():
+        if ':module_ref:' in component['vlnv']:
+            continue
+        a = next(original.rglob(component['xci_name'] + '.xci'))
+        b = next(generated.rglob(new['components'][name]['xci_name'] + '.xci'))
+        x, y = values(a), values(b)
+        differences = []
+        for key in sorted(set(x) | set(y)):
+            if not key.startswith(('PARAM_VALUE.', 'MODELPARAM_VALUE.', 'BUSIFPARAM_VALUE.')) or x.get(key) == y.get(key):
+                continue
+            before, after = x.get(key), y.get(key)
+            reason = None
+            if key in ['PARAM_VALUE.Component_Name', 'MODELPARAM_VALUE.TLM_COMPONENT_NAME']:
+                if after == b.stem:
+                    reason = 'regenerated instance name; no hardware parameter change'
+            elif name == 'ps8_0_axi_periph' and key == 'PARAM_VALUE.NUM_MI' and (before, after) == ('11', '12'):
+                reason = 'authorized additional M11 AHIL destination'
+            elif name == 'zynq_ultra_ps_e_0':
+                parameter = key.removeprefix('PARAM_VALUE.')
+                if parameter == 'PSU__PROTECTION__SLAVES':
+                    extra = {'FPD;FPD_GPV;FD700000;FD7FFFFF;1', 'FPD;CCI_GPV;FD6E0000;FD6EFFFF;1'}
+                    if set(after.replace('\n', '').split('|')) == set(before.replace('\n', '').split('|')) | extra:
+                        reason = '2020.1 generated protection metadata; new PS initialization forbidden'
+                inactive = {'PSU__M_AXI_GP1__FREQMHZ': ('PSU__USE__M_AXI_GP1', '200.0', '10'),
+                            'PSU__M_AXI_GP2__FREQMHZ': ('PSU__USE__M_AXI_GP2', '100.0', '10'),
+                            'PSU__S_AXI_GP0__FREQMHZ': ('PSU__USE__S_AXI_GP0', '200.0', '10'),
+                            'PSU__S_AXI_GP2__FREQMHZ': ('PSU__USE__S_AXI_GP2', '200.0', '10'),
+                            'PSU__S_AXI_GP4__FREQMHZ': ('PSU__USE__S_AXI_GP4', '200.0', '10'),
+                            'PSU__S_AXI_GP5__FREQMHZ': ('PSU__USE__S_AXI_GP5', '200.0', '10'),
+                            'PSU__SAXIGP0__DATA_WIDTH': ('PSU__USE__S_AXI_GP0', '32', '128')}
+                if parameter in inactive:
+                    enable, expected_a, expected_b = inactive[parameter]
+                    if x['PARAM_VALUE.' + enable] == y['PARAM_VALUE.' + enable] == '0' and (before, after) == (expected_a, expected_b):
+                        reason = 'metadata of a disabled PS AXI interface'
+                if parameter == 'PSU__NUM_F2P0__INTR__INPUTS' and (before, after) == ('7', '1') and name + '/pl_ps_irq0' not in used:
+                    reason = 'unused/unconnected IRQ0 input width; connected IRQ1 unchanged'
+            if name == 'xlconcat_3' and re.fullmatch(r'(?:MODEL)?PARAM_VALUE.IN(?:3[2-9]|[4-9][0-9]|1[01][0-9]|12[0-7])_WIDTH', key) and (before, after) == ('1', None):
+                if x['PARAM_VALUE.NUM_PORTS'] == y['PARAM_VALUE.NUM_PORTS'] == '6':
+                    reason = 'removed metadata for nonexistent inputs >=32; six active inputs unchanged'
+            if key.startswith('BUSIFPARAM_VALUE.'):
+                interface = key.split('.')[1]
+                if name + '/' + interface not in used:
+                    reason = 'unconnected/disabled interface descriptor; no connected bus change'
+                elif name in ['axi_iic_0', 'axi_iic_1'] and key in [
+                        'BUSIFPARAM_VALUE.S_AXI.NUM_READ_OUTSTANDING',
+                        'BUSIFPARAM_VALUE.S_AXI.NUM_WRITE_OUTSTANDING'] and (before, after) == ('1', '2'):
+                    reason = '2020.1 AXI-IIC outstanding capability metadata; core model parameters unchanged'
+            if reason is None:
+                raise ValueError('unreviewed 2020.1 XCI difference: %s/%s %r -> %r' %
+                                 (name, key, str(before)[:120], str(after)[:120]))
+            differences.append(dict(parameter=key, original=before, native=after, reason=reason))
+        report[name] = dict(original=str(a), native=str(b), vlnv=component['vlnv'], differences=differences)
+    return report

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Explicit experimental 2020.1 reconstruction, never an in-place IP downgrade.
+
+Create a NEW output tree and Tcl from the archived camera BD's public
+configuration. Instantiate the same VLNV families in the installed 2020.1
+catalog, then restore the original connections/address map and append AHIL.
+The archived BD/XCI are inputs only. No upgrade_ip or PS initialization is run.
+"""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import sys
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

+
+def quote(value):
+    value = str(value)
+    if any(c in value for c in '{}\\\n\r'):
+        raise ValueError('unsupported Tcl braced value: ' + repr(value))
+    return '{' + value + '}'
+
+
+def size(value):
+    return int(value[:-1]) * {'K': 1024, 'M': 1024**2, 'G': 1024**3}[value[-1]]
+
+
+def prepare(output, stage, repair_csi=False):
+    if output.exists():
+        raise ValueError('refusing existing output: ' + str(output))
+    manifest = json.loads((CAMERA / 'manifest.json').read_text())
+    for name, expected in manifest['sha256'].items():
+        if hashlib.sha256((CAMERA / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected:
+            raise ValueError('original camera input changed: ' + name)
+    design = json.loads((CAMERA / 'project' / BD).read_text())['design']
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    shutil.copytree(CAMERA / 'project', output / 'source')
+    shutil.copytree(UNIFIED / 'rtl', output / 'hil_rtl')
+    csi_changes = []
+    if repair_csi:
+        from csi_patch import patch_source
+        csi_changes = patch_source(output / 'source')
+        shutil.copy2(HERE / 'fix_netlist.tcl', output / 'fix_netlist.tcl')
+        shutil.copy2(HERE / 'csi_delay_reference.v', output / 'csi_delay_reference.v')
+        shutil.copy2(HERE / 'mipi_nominal.xdc', output / 'mipi_nominal.xdc')
+    script = []
+    def emit(line):
+        script.append(line)
+    emit('if {[version -short] ne "2020.1"} {error "Experimental reconstruction requires installed Vivado 2020.1"}')
+    emit('set out ' + quote(output.as_posix()))
+    emit('create_project mipi_dp [file join $out vivado] -part xczu19eg-ffvc1760-2-i')
+    emit('set_property ip_repo_paths [list [file join $out source repo]] [current_project]')
+    emit('update_ip_catalog')

+        emit('set_property XPM_LIBRARIES {XPM_CDC XPM_FIFO XPM_MEMORY} [current_project]')
+    for group, names in manifest['source_groups'].items():
+        if group != 'sources_1':
+            continue
+        for name in names:
+            if name.endswith('.bd') or name.endswith('design_1_wrapper.v'):
+                continue
+            emit('add_files -norecurse [file join $out source ' + quote(name) + ']')

+# Preserve the original experiment and create a separate implementation run.
+# -source repair_clock.tcl -tclargs ORIGINAL_BUILD NEW_REPORT_DIR ?diagnose|impl?
+# No reset_runs, IP edits, constraint overwrites, PS init or hardware access.
+if {[version -short] ne "2020.1" || $argc < 2 || $argc > 3} {error "Requires 2020.1 and ORIGINAL_BUILD NEW_REPORT_DIR ?diagnose|impl?"}
+set build [file normalize [lindex $argv 0]]
+set result [file normalize [lindex $argv 1]]
+set stage [expr {$argc == 3 ? [lindex $argv 2] : "diagnose"}]
+if {$stage ni {diagnose impl}} {error "Expected diagnose or impl"}
+if {[file exists $result]} {error "Refusing existing result directory"}
+file mkdir $result
+file copy [file normalize [info script]] [file join $result repair_clock_executed.tcl]
+open_project [file join $build vivado mipi_dp.xpr]
+if {[get_property PROGRESS [get_runs synth_1]] ne "100%"} {error "Successful original synthesis required"}
+# Select a fresh constraint set before opening the synthesized netlist, so the
+# failed attempt's live_clock.xdc is never applied during source discovery.
+set constrset [expr {$stage eq "diagnose" ? "clock_diagnose" : "live_clock_fixed"}]
+set run [expr {$stage eq "diagnose" ? "diagnose_liveclock" : "impl_liveclock"}]
+create_fileset -constrset $constrset
+foreach name {system.xdc mipi.xdc QSFP.xdc ddr4_set.xdc mipi2.xdc} {
+    add_files -fileset $constrset -norecurse [file join $build source mipi_dp.srcs constrs_1 new $name]
+}
+create_run $run -parent_run synth_1 -flow {Vivado Implementation 2020} -strategy {Vivado Implementation Defaults} -constrset $constrset
+current_run -implementation [get_runs $run]
+open_run synth_1
+set xdc [file join $result live_clock_single_source.xdc]
+set f [open $xdc w]
+foreach index {0 1} {
+    set period [expr {1.0e9 * (1 + $index) / 200703980}]
+    set clk [get_clocks clk_pl_$index]
+    set sources [get_property SOURCE_PINS $clk]
+    # Read the original PS clock, before adding the new constraint set.
+    if {[llength $clk] != 1 || [llength $sources] != 1} {error "Expected original single-source PS clock $index: $sources"}
+    puts "ORIGINAL_CLOCK_SOURCE clk_pl_$index $sources"
+    puts $f "create_clock -name clk_pl_$index -period $period \[get_pins \{$sources\}\]"
+}
+close $f
+close_design
+add_files -fileset $constrset -norecurse $xdc
+set_property USED_IN_SYNTHESIS false [get_files $xdc]
+set_property PROCESSING_ORDER LATE [get_files $xdc]
+if {$stage eq "impl"} {
+    launch_runs $run -to_step write_bitstream -jobs 4
+    wait_on_run $run
+    if {[get_property PROGRESS [get_runs $run]] ne "100%"} {error "Corrected-clock implementation failed"}
+    open_run $run
+} else {
+    open_checkpoint [file join $build vivado mipi_dp.runs impl_1 design_1_wrapper_routed.dcp]
+    read_xdc $xdc
+}
+report_clocks -file [file join $result clocks_impl.rpt]
+set f [open [file join $result clock_sources.txt] w]
+foreach index {0 1} {
+    set clk [get_clocks clk_pl_$index]
+    if {[llength $clk] != 1 || [llength [get_property SOURCE_PINS $clk]] != 1} {error "Final PL clock must have one source"}
+    puts $f "clk_pl_$index\t[get_property PERIOD $clk]\t[get_property SOURCE_PINS $clk]"
+}
+close $f
+report_timing_summary -report_unconstrained -file [file join $result timing_impl.rpt]
+report_drc -file [file join $result drc_impl.rpt]
+report_methodology -file [file join $result methodology_impl.rpt]
+if {$stage eq "impl"} {
+    write_hw_platform -fixed -include_bit [file join $result camera_hil.xsa]
+    set f [open [file join $result implementation.json] w]
+    puts $f "\{\"build\":\"$build\",\"implementation_run\":\"impl_liveclock\",\"repair\":\"single-source live clocks; no IP or PS edits\"\}"
+} else {
+    set f [open [file join $result diagnosis.json] w]
+    puts $f "\{\"build\":\"$build\",\"stage\":\"routed DCP reanalysis only\",\"implementation_rerun\":false,\"corrected_bit_created\":false\}"
+}
+close $f
+puts "REPAIRED_CLOCK_DONE stage=$stage; no board validation"

+"""Run focused vendor-XSim fault tests in a NEW offline output directory."""
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--vivado', type=Path, default=Path('F:/Xilinx/Vivado/2020.1'))
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    out = args.output.resolve()
+    if out.exists():
+        raise ValueError('refusing existing output directory')
+    out.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name in ['csi_clock_detector.vhd', 'csi_cdc_helpers.v', 'csi_delay_reference.v',
+                 'test_cdc.sv', 'test_fifo.sv', 'test_reference.sv']:
+        shutil.copy2(HERE / name, out / name)
+    cmds = []
+    def run(tool, *argv):
+        cmd = [str(args.vivado / 'bin' / (tool + '.bat')), *map(str, argv)]
+        cmds.append(cmd)
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=out, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        with (out / 'transcript.txt').open('ab') as log:
+            log.write(('COMMAND ' + json.dumps(cmd) + '\n').encode())
+            log.write(proc.stdout)
+        proc.check_returncode()
+    data = args.vivado / 'data'
+    run('xvlog', '--sv', data / 'ip/xpm/xpm_cdc/hdl/xpm_cdc.sv',
+        data / 'ip/xpm/xpm_memory/hdl/xpm_memory.sv', data / 'ip/xpm/xpm_fifo/hdl/xpm_fifo.sv', '--work', 'xpm')
+    run('xvhdl', '--work', 'xpm', data / 'ip/xpm/xpm_VCOMP.vhd')
+    run('xvhdl', 'csi_clock_detector.vhd')
+    run('xvlog', '--sv', 'csi_cdc_helpers.v', 'csi_delay_reference.v',
+        'test_cdc.sv', 'test_fifo.sv', 'test_reference.sv')
+    run('xvlog', data / 'verilog/src/glbl.v')
+    for top, marker in [('test_cdc', 'PASS_CDC'), ('test_fifo', 'PASS_VENDOR_FIFO'),
+                        ('test_reference', 'PASS_REFERENCE')]:
+        run('xelab', top, 'glbl', '-L', 'xpm', '-L', 'unisims_ver', '-s', top + '_faults')
+        run('xsim', top + '_faults', '-runall', '-log', top + '.log')
+        text = (out / (top + '.log')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+        if marker not in text or 'Fatal:' in text or 'Error:' in text:
+            raise ValueError('fault test failed: ' + top)
+    manifest = dict(commands=cmds, scope='offline local faults, not sensor/board acceptance',
+                    source_sha256={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+                                   for p in out.iterdir() if p.suffix in ['.v','.vhd','.sv']})
+    (out / 'tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
+    print('PASS: clock/RDY/FIFO/reference faults; ' + str(out))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Exact v2 -> structural private-source transformation, auditable from archive."""
+from pathlib import Path
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT = Path('repo/mipi/mipi_csi_rx_4lane/src/mipi-csi-rx')
+
+
+def apply_structural(source):
+    def once(text, old, new):
+        if text.count(old) != 1:
+            raise ValueError('structural context not unique: '+old[:70])
+        return text.replace(old, new)
+
+    def edit(name, old, new):
+        p = source / ROOT / name
+        text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+        if text.count(old) != 1:
+            raise ValueError('structural patch context not unique: '+name+': '+old[:70])
+        p.write_text(text.replace(old,new),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
+    p = source / ROOT / 'csi_rx_clock_det.vhd'
+    notice = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('entity csi_rx_clock_det is')[0]
+    p.write_text(notice + (HERE/'csi_clock_detector.vhd').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
+    # Reset combiners formerly fed multiple domains directly. Only qualified
+    # ref-domain state crosses one XPM reset, then application uses local reset.
+    link = source / ROOT / 'csi_rx_4_lane_link.vhd'
+    text = link.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+    start = text.index('  -- Primitive IO reset releases')
+    end = text.index('  gen_no_idctl',start)
+    text = text[:start] + """  -- Initial primitive IO reset remains independent of sensor clocks/RDY.
+  phy_reset <= io_reset or (serdes_reset_det and application_ready);
+  delay_ready <= rdy;
+  word_valid <= word_valid_int and application_ready;
+  qualification : entity work.csi_application_gate
+    port map(byte_clk=>word_clock_int, qualified=>all_ready,
+             ready=>application_ready, reset_byte=>application_reset_byte);
+  serdes_reset <= serdes_reset_det or application_reset_byte or not application_ready;
+""" + text[end:]
+    # Mixed-language component binding is explicit, supported by Vivado.
+    text = once(text, '  signal ready_byte : std_logic_vector(1 downto 0) := "00";',
+        '  signal ready_byte : std_logic_vector(1 downto 0) := "00";\n  signal application_reset_byte : std_logic;')
+    text = once(text, '  attribute ASYNC_REG : string;', """  component csi_application_gate is
+    port(byte_clk, qualified : in std_logic; ready, reset_byte : out std_logic);
+  end component;
+  attribute ASYNC_REG : string;""")
+    text = once(text, 'qualification : entity work.csi_application_gate','qualification : csi_application_gate')
+    link.write_text(text,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
+    edit('csi_rx_top.vhd', '    byte_clock_out : out std_logic;',
+         '    rx_reset_out : out std_logic;\n    byte_clock_out : out std_logic;')
+    edit('csi_rx_top.vhd', '   byte_clock_out <= csi_byte_clock;',
+         '   rx_reset_out <= link_reset_out;\n   byte_clock_out <= csi_byte_clock;')
+    # Remove the redundant OR-before-reset-synchronizer in every lane. Runtime
+    # detector reset is already a byte-domain XPM output; calibration primitive
+    # reset still releases before CTRL with no RDY or camera clock dependency.
+    edit('csi_rx_hs_lane_phy.vhd',
+        """  process(byte_clock, reset)
+  begin
+    if reset = '1' then
+      reset_sync <= "11";
+    elsif rising_edge(byte_clock) then
+      reset_sync <= reset_sync(0) & '0';
+    end if;
+  end process;
+  reset_lat <= reset_sync(1);
+  primitive_reset <= io_reset or (reset_lat and application_ready);""",
+        """  reset_lat <= reset;
+  primitive_reset <= reset;""")
+    # UG949 ISERDESE3 guidance: one CLK net on both pins, local inversion.
+    edit('csi_rx_hs_lane_phy.vhd', "IS_CLK_B_INVERTED => '0',   -- Optional inversion for CLK_B",
+         "IS_CLK_B_INVERTED => '1',   -- Local inversion; same physical CLK net")
+    edit('csi_rx_hs_lane_phy.vhd', 'CLK_B => ddr_bit_clock_b,', 'CLK_B => ddr_bit_clock,')
+    # BUFGCE_DIV clear release follows the undivided clock, which is available
+    # independently of DIV output. No reset circularity on a stopped byte clock.
+    edit('csi_rx_hs_clk_phy.vhd', 'use UNISIM.VComponents.all;',
+         'use UNISIM.VComponents.all;\nlibrary xpm;\nuse xpm.vcomponents.all;')
+    edit('csi_rx_hs_clk_phy.vhd', 'signal byte_clock_int : std_logic;',
+         'signal byte_clock_int : std_logic;\nsignal divider_reset : std_logic;')
+    edit('csi_rx_hs_clk_phy.vhd', '  gen_us: if series = "ULTRASCALE_PLUS"generate',

+"""Protect the private CSI exception against an extra/unreviewed source change."""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+from csi_patch import ROOT, patch_source, verify_patches
+
+CAMERA = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'camera_hw'
+
+
+class PrivatePatchGate(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_exact_private_patch_passes_and_additional_delta_is_rejected(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ah-csi-gate-') as folder:
+            build = Path(folder)
+            source = build / 'source'
+            shutil.copytree(CAMERA / 'project' / ROOT, source / ROOT)
+            component = ROOT.parent.parent / 'component.xml'
+            shutil.copy2(CAMERA / 'project' / component, source / component)
+            ledger = patch_source(source)
+            self.assertEqual(len(verify_patches(CAMERA, build, ledger)), 7)
+            path = source / ROOT / 'csi_4lane_raw10.v'
+            path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes() + b'\n// unreviewed delta\n')
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'differs from exact patch'):
+                verify_patches(CAMERA, build, ledger)
+            altered = json.loads(json.dumps(ledger))
+            altered[0]['patched_sha256'] = '0' * 64
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'ledger differs'):
+                verify_patches(CAMERA, build, altered)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Package a strictly audited 2020.2 or explicit experimental 2020.1 implementation."""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tarfile
+import zipfile
+
+from audit import HERE, CAMERA, CLOCK_HZ, build_audit, require, sha, source_audit
+
+CAMERA_SHA = 'e25e9bc7fd4c2008c7a198a91bc4937716b333259d08da7ed777d8ffe9b3384b'
+
+
+def check_cdc(build, tool='2020.1'):
+    """The new multi-domain reference repair also requires a real CDC signoff."""
+    report = (build / 'cdc_impl.rpt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+    require(re.search(r'Tool Version\s*:\s*Vivado v\.' + re.escape(tool) + r'\b', report)
+            and re.search(r'Design\s*:\s*design_1_wrapper\b', report), 'wrong/missing CDC report provenance')
+    summary = report.split('Source Clock:', 1)[0]
+    rows = re.findall(r'^CDC-\d+\s+(Critical|Warning|Info)\s+(\d+)\s+', summary, re.M)
+    require(rows, 'CDC summary rows missing')
+    critical = sum(int(count) for severity, count in rows if severity == 'Critical')
+    require(critical == 0, 'CDC signoff failed: %d Critical findings' % critical)
+
+
+def check_bus_skew(build, tool='2020.1'):
+    """XPM Gray pointers carry instance-scoped bus-skew constraints too."""
+    report = (build / 'bus_skew_impl.rpt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+    require(re.search(r'Tool Version\s*:\s*Vivado v\.' + re.escape(tool) + r'\b', report)
+            and re.search(r'Design\s*:\s*design_1_wrapper\b', report), 'wrong/missing bus-skew report provenance')
+    slacks = re.findall(r'Slack \((MET|VIOLATED)\)\s*:\s*([-0-9.]+)ns', report)
+    require(slacks and all(status == 'MET' and float(value) >= 0 for status, value in slacks),
+            'bus-skew signoff failed or missing')
+
+
+def check_reports(build, tool='2020.2', require_sources=False):
+    require(tool in ['2020.1', '2020.2'], 'unsupported report tool profile')
+    timing = (build / 'timing_impl.rpt').read_text()
+    drc = (build / 'drc_impl.rpt').read_text()
+    for report in [timing, drc]:
+        require(re.search(r'Tool Version\s*:\s*Vivado v\.' + re.escape(tool) + r'\b', report),
+                'reports need Vivado ' + tool)
+        require(re.search(r'Design\s*:\s*design_1_wrapper\b', report), 'wrong report design')
+    require('All user specified timing constraints are met.' in timing, 'timing constraints failed')
+    require(re.search(r'Violations found:\s+0\s', drc), 'DRC must have zero violations')
+    for clock, expected in [('clk_pl_0', 1e9 / CLOCK_HZ), ('clk_pl_1', 2e9 / CLOCK_HZ)]:
+        match = re.search(r'^' + clock + r'\s+\{[^}]+\}\s+([0-9.]+)\s+', timing, re.M)
+        require(match and abs(float(match[1]) - expected) < .001,
+                'timing report must use live period: ' + clock)
+    for check in ['no_clock', 'unconstrained_internal_endpoints', 'no_input_delay',
+                  'no_output_delay', 'multiple_clock', 'generated_clocks', 'loops',
+                  'partial_input_delay', 'partial_output_delay', 'latch_loops']:
+        require(re.search(r'checking ' + check + r' \(0\)', timing), 'timing coverage failed: ' + check)
+    if require_sources:
+        require((build / 'clocks_impl.rpt').is_file(), 'actual report_clocks missing')
+        rows = [line.split('\t') for line in (build / 'clock_sources.txt').read_text().splitlines()]
+        require(len(rows) == 2 and {row[0] for row in rows} == {'clk_pl_0', 'clk_pl_1'},

+        for row in rows:
+            require(len(row) == 3 and len(row[2].split()) == 1, 'clock source must be unique')
+            period = (1 if row[0] == 'clk_pl_0' else 2) * 1e9 / CLOCK_HZ
+            require(abs(float(row[1]) - period) < .001, 'final clock-source period mismatch')
+
+
+def convert(bootgen, output, stem):
+    (output / (stem + '.bif')).write_text('all:\n{\n  [destination_device=pl] ' + stem + '.bit\n}\n', encoding='ascii')
+    subprocess.run([str(bootgen), '-arch', 'zynqmp', '-image', stem + '.bif',
